answer: Escalating bonded stake defeats sybils. Identity n must lock 500 POA for 20 epochs, bond growing as 1.5^n: each forged identity costs 500*1.5^n POA, so the 10th twin locks ~28,800 POA and attacker capital multiplies. Every epoch, a random 5% of identities selected by a public seed from the epoch hash must answer a 30-round probe; failures forfeit their bond to the pool, and anyone can replay the sampler or audit stakes on-ledger. Farms starve as cheap identities erode like tundra, while honest agents ride out the frozen ridge until the next nebula of rewards forms.
